title: Avoid episode leakage
scope: Group-disjoint split reasoning, not generalization measurement

items.solution: Intersection=['e2']. Splitting frames from the same episode across sets leaks episode-specific context.

items.prompt: Sensor records are named person/session. Train=['person-A/session-1', 'person-B/session-1']; held-out=['person-A/session-2']. Evaluation requires PERSON-disjoint groups, not just distinct sessions. Is there person overlap? Return yes or no. Fit any preprocessing only on training records. Tolerance ±0.001 for numeric fields; follow the stated units.
items.solution: Extract the person group before comparing sets. Different session names do not prevent subject leakage. This checks the declared split rule, not generalization quality.
